verses.text: Then the LORD said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have seen that you are the only good person in this generation.
Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its female, and one pair of every kind of animal that is not clean, a male and its female.
Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep every kind alive on the whole earth.
Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will wipe out from the face of the earth every living thing I have made."
Noah did everything the LORD commanded him.
Noah was six hundred years old when the flood waters came on the earth.
Noah and his sons, his wife and his sons' wives went into the ark to escape the flood waters.
Clean and unclean animals, birds, and all the creatures that move along the ground
came to Noah in pairs, male and female, and went into the ark, just as God had commanded Noah.
After the seven days, the flood waters came on the earth.
When Noah was six hundred years old, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the springs of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
Rain fell on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, went into the ark, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons.
With them went every kind of wild animal, every kind of farm animal, every kind of creature that moves along the ground, and every kind of bird, everything with wings.
Pairs of every creature that has the breath of life in it came to Noah and went into the ark.
The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth. As the waters rose, they lifted the ark high above the ground.
The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
The waters rose higher and higher over the earth, until all the high mountains under the whole sky were covered.
The waters rose more than seven metres above the mountains and covered them.
Every living thing that moved on the earth died: birds, farm animals, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all human beings.
Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in it died.

Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out: people, animals, creatures that move along the ground, and birds in the sky. They were wiped off the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ark.
The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.
